verdict.rationale: Cal.com's event-type API documents several parts of this story: creating event types, offering multiple durations, adding custom booking fields, and setting a per-event-type conferencing location. Confirmation rules are only implied, through bookings 'awaiting host confirmation' and a BOOKING_REQUESTED webhook trigger; no event-type setting for requiring confirmation is documented. One community report says the free tier dropped to 1 active event type after a trial, which limits offering multiple event types. Missing for 10: documented per-event-type confirmation/approval settings, a clear statement that unlimited multiple event types are available on the founder's plan, and independent hands-on corroboration of these settings.
